item.tib: gter bdag yum sras sde lnga dril sgrub cha lag u dpal dga' tshal rgyas pa
item.coloph: zhes gter bdag yum sras sde lnga'i dril sgrub kyi cha lag bsdus don 'di ni/ bya btang gi rnal 'byor ba (?)dge sbyor yar me ba rang skad du nyi ri wer zhi'am lha tshogs 'phags pa'i skad du sur+Ya d+d+har dzas yang nas yang du bskul pa rang snang dag pa'i shar tshul la sangs rgyas bon gyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du 'byung ba'i ltas nges bsnyed du byung ba'i ngos/ rgyal khams pa rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal lam/ g.yung drung thogs med bdud 'dul snying pos sa 'brug gro bzhin zla ba'i nam can 'du tshogs kyi dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshes la/ 'du gnas rin chen 'bar ba rtsa rgya'i khyud kun grags mthong grol khrod du 'phral brtsams pa'i 'gal ba gang mchis rtsa gsum srung ma bcas bshags shing*/ 'di byas kyi dge tshogs mchis so cog dag dus gsum gyi dge rtsa dang 'dres te g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur nas mar gyur thams cad zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i sku 'thob par gyur cig/
